instruction:
The CAE work moves through three software stages: AutoCAD -> SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. Use the AutoCAD 2024, SOLIDWORKS 2025, and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop as the three stages of this workflow. No init files are provided; start from blank files.

Handoff requirement: use the design token EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_04. In AutoCAD, add a readable label containing EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_04 and AUTOCAD_TO_SOLIDWORKS on a CHAIN layer in stage1_profile.dxf. In SolidWorks, keep EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_04, FROM_stage1_profile.dxf, and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS encoded in the part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage2_geometry.step contains them. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_04 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage2_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In AutoCAD, draw one closed dogbone outline on OUTLINE through these vertices in millimeters: (0,0), (25,0), (35,8), (105,8), (115,0), (140,0), (140,40), (115,40), (105,32), (35,32), (25,40), and (0,40). This defines 25 mm grip lengths, 10 mm linear shoulders, 40 mm grip width, and 24 mm gauge width. Draw one D10 hole centered at (70,20) on HOLE and the two grip-end markers on GRIP. Save stage1_profile.dxf.
2. In SolidWorks, import the DXF in millimeters, create the shoulder/grip coupon as one 3 mm thick solid, cut the D10 center hole through, and export stage2_geometry.step.
3. In Abaqus/CAE, import the STEP into Model-DogboneTension. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, assign a solid section, and create Static General step Step-Tension. Create sets LEFT_GRIP, RIGHT_GRIP, and HOLE_EDGE. Fix LEFT_GRIP with BC-LeftGrip. Couple RIGHT_GRIP with Coupling-RightGrip and apply the unique tensile action Load-RightGrip1000N with CF1=+1000 N. Use first-order C3D4 or C3D8R elements, no more than 1000 nodes, submit Job-DogboneTension, and wait for completion.

4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DogboneTension.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DogboneTension.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

First use AutoCAD to create the DXF profile, then use SolidWorks to import the DXF and export the STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; AutoCAD 2024 (English): `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024 - English.lnk`.
